name: MultiAgentBench
description: MultiAgentBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate large language model-based multi-agent systems across diverse interactive scenarios, measuring task completion as well as the quality of collaboration and competition using milestone-based key performance indicators.
reputation: A recent benchmark for evaluating multi-agent LLM systems that is still emerging in the research community.
notes: Evaluates multi-agent coordination protocols and strategies such as group discussion and cognitive planning; includes public code and datasets.
